dt: Abstracts were due Oct 27, 2026; full proposals due Dec 18, 2026 (DARPA-PS-26-141)
e: Funds new ways to synthesize polymers and nonlinear optical materials with molecular-level control, with sub-nanosecond electro-optic modulators as the target application. It suits teams that combine synthesis, computation, characterization, microfabrication and photonics; universities can take part.
n: DARPA: Atomically Precise Molecules (APM) – precision polymers and nonlinear optical materials
unv: The solicitation page (darpa-ps-26-141) now redirects to DARPA's general opportunities list; the APM program page lists DARPA-PS-26-141 with only "Deadline: Oct. 27, 2026" (the abstract date). DARPA's APM Q&A confirms Other Transaction agreements and that non-US organizations may not take part. The Dec 18, 2026 full-proposal date comes from consultant summaries of the SAM.gov notice, and whether an abstract was required to submit a full proposal was not confirmed.
